name: DotGlow: LED Matrix Clock
description: DotGlow is the Android companion app for DIY LED matrix clocks built with an ESP32 or ESP32-S3 and a MAX7219 display, by MTP Code / Manoranjan (ElectroIoT). Pair a clock over encrypted Bluetooth with the PIN shown on its LEDs, set up its WiFi, change every setting with a live LED preview, run the stopwatch, update the firmware over Bluetooth, and install firmware on new ESP32 / ESP32-S3 / ESP8266 boards straight from the phone over USB-OTG. No account, no ads, no tracking. Package ID: com.electroiot.dotglow. Support: admin@mtpcode.com.
features: Finds DotGlow clocks nearby; secure pairing with a 6-digit PIN shown on the clock's LEDs (LE Secure Connections)
Live LED matrix preview that draws exactly what the clock shows: clock, digit styles, effects, messages, stopwatch
WiFi setup through the clock — scan and join networks from the app; the clock fetches internet time by itself
Every setting: 12/24 h, time zone, colon, seconds bar, date, night mode, auto brightness, 4–16 modules, mirror/flip, one-tap Rotate 180°
6 digit-change styles and 5 effects (hourly and at power-on), scrolling messages and special days
Built-in stopwatch, also controllable with an optional push button on the clock
Firmware updates over Bluetooth (no WiFi needed) or from GitHub over WiFi
Install firmware on new ESP32, ESP32-S3 and ESP8266 (NodeMCU) boards over USB-OTG — no computer needed
Step-by-step setup guide with wiring pictures, power tips and troubleshooting
Optional app lock with PIN and fingerprint
Demo clock to explore every screen without hardware
No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking

notes: First release: Bluetooth setup with PIN pairing, WiFi setup, every clock setting with live LED previews
Firmware updates over Bluetooth and a USB firmware installer for new boards
Setup guide with wiring pictures and a demo clock
